Applicant :- Santosh Kumar Pandey Opposite Party :- State of U.P.
Counsel for Applicant :- Manoj Kumar Dwivedi Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Ajay Bhanot,J.
By means of the the bail application the applicant has prayed to be enlarged on bail in Case Crime No. 274 of 2023 at Police Station-Jhangaha, District-Gorakhpur under Sections 376, 506 I.P.C.
The applicant is in jail since 23.06.2023.
The bail application of the applicant was rejected by the learned trial court on 05.08.2023.

The following arguments made by Shri Manoj Kumar Dwivedi, learned counsel on behalf of the applicant, which could not be satisfactorily refuted by Shri Chandan Agrawal, learned AGA for the State from the record, entitle the applicant for grant of bail:
(1).
The applicant and the victim were intimate.

Santosh Kumar Pandey vs State Of U.P. on 19 September, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/56801741/
1 (2).

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: The FIR is a result of the said relationship going awry.
(3). The applicant never gave a plighted word to marry the victim.
(4). The FIR is being leveraged to force the applicant to marry her.
(5). The prosecution has not produced any medical evidence to corroborate commission of rape.
(6). The applicant does not have any criminal history apart from this case.
(7). The applicant is not a flight risk.
The applicant being a law abiding citizen has always cooperated with the investigation and undertakes to join the trial proceedings.
There is no possibility of his influencing witnesses, tampering with the evidence or reoffending.
In the light of the preceding discussion and without making any observations on the merits of the case, the bail application is allowed.

Let the applicant-Santosh Kumar Pandey be released on bail in the aforesaid case crime number, on furnishing a personal bond and two sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of the court below.

The following conditions be imposed in the interest of justice:-
(i) The applicant will not tamper with the evidence or influence any witness during the trial.
(ii) The applicant will appear before the trial court on the date fixed, unless personal presence is exempted.

Order Date :- 19.9.2023 Vandit  Santosh Kumar Pandey vs State Of U.P. on 19 September, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/56801741/
